messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer is uncertain whether the letters module and its email system integration are still functioning correctly.
  quote: One last thing — are the letters module and integrations with our email system still working as expected?
- problem: The customer is unsure if the policyholder letters will show the updated reserves after a sync.
  quote: Just to confirm — will the letters to policyholders also reflect the corrected reserves after this sync?
- problem: The user wants confirmation that policyholder letters are still generated via the letters tab.
  quote: Perfect — and just to confirm, all policyholder letters are still generated through the letters tab, right?
